requirement: The Add site popup asks the questions of the chosen template's own questionnaire, offers AI rewrite on the long-text question, and its answers reach the site by question id

oracle.ref: PR #859 (feat); fix evidence: 04/10/2026: the popup asked three fixed questions (about, goal, style) while every template already has a questionnaire an administrator edits in /ops; a site with no shop was asked whether visitors should buy products. The popup now draws the questionnaire the Build form would draw, and /ops edits reach the next customer without a deploy.
oracle.invariant: Every run exits 0 with 0 failures and 0 skipped tests. e2e 'the sheet slides over the panel with the template's own questions…' passes: Tracy Business draws Sector (Recommended), Company name, What does the company do? and the Site language picker; the licence question that belongs to one sector is not drawn. 'the card sits quietly…' checks GET /api/sites/questions was asked with design=tracy-business. e2e 'another template asks other questions…' passes: Tracy Base on WordPress draws exactly Business name and One line about your business. e2e 'Create site sends the answers with the hash of the set they answer; a hidden answer does not travel' passes: choosing Construction draws the licence question, changing the sector removes it and its answer does not travel. Same test: the POST /api/sites body carries brief = {answers: {name, about, sector}, questionnaire: <64 hex>}. e2e 'when the questions cannot load the card says so…' passes: a 503 from the questions door shows the failed card and Create site sends no brief. e2e 'AI rewrite is offered on the long-text question and not on the others; Undo puts the words back' passes: exactly one AI rewrite button, under the longtext question; off while the box is empty; pressing it asks POST /api/sites/brief/rewrite once with the typed words, the 200 answer replaces the text, and Undo brings the customer's own words back. e2e 'a rewrite the door refuses with 429/503…' and 'a rewrite that comes back after the customer edited the text…' pass: a refusal is said beside the button and leaves the words as typed; a late answer never overwrites an edit. sites-route 'POST /api/sites/brief/rewrite: capped per person per hour' passes (part of S2). sites-route 'POST /api/sites with answers by question id…' passes: an unknown question and an option the question does not offer are dropped, a hash the server never served is judged against today's set, and answers to nothing the set asks start no brief. site-brief-normalize 'a name typed into the name question…', 'the languages picked…' and 'the sector answer…' pass: the name and the languages are the customer's as typed, the sector is the option's label, and a phone typed into another question is found as a fact the customer gave. Not covered by this case: a real model reading the answers, the text and pictures an Apply writes into a running site, and init time (measured with the apply bench kit, not here).
